analysis.overall: You spent 78% of the day in range with a beautifully flat overnight line, though stacked corrections around lunchtime brought on a sharp low and a high rebound spike.

events.title: Late-evening spike
events.description: Glucose climbed to a peak of 243 mg/dL following evening carbs, taking several small correction doses a few hours to pull back into range.

events.title: Steady overnight baseline
events.description: Levels remained flat and stable between 110–140 mg/dL all through the night with automated basal adjustments doing their job.

events.title: Breakfast pre-bolus success
events.description: Dosing 5.6u for 70g of carbs worked great, holding your glucose remarkably steady around 150–160 mg/dL for over two hours.

events.title: Midday low & fast rebound
events.description: Multiple small correction doses in the late morning combined to push your glucose down to 66 mg/dL, followed by a sharp rebound rise up to 238 mg/dL.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Watch out for stacking multiple correction doses closely together late in the morning, as the delayed insulin overlap caused a sharp drop into a low.
